title: Reproduce, Then Attribute: A Controlled Study of the LLM Training Lifecycle on a Bit-Exact Qwen3-0.6B Reproduction
headline: A bit-exact 0.6B reproduction carried through the full training lifecycle: two attributed wins under single-variable iso-FLOP controls (the modernized-bundle de-confound; the mid-training premium-data anneal), three honest nulls (SFT response-masking, GRPO-at-scale, context extension), and the evidence-gating methodology that caught two of the project's own recorded claims being wrong.
blocking_check: PASS — every headline component is BACKED (multi-seed CI + iso-FLOP where comparative; bit-exact where reproductive); no headline rests on a LIMITATION.

BACKED.claim: Qwen3-0.6B repro bit-exact vs HF (max|Δlogits|=0.0, argmax match; single-prompt fp32 protocol stated)
De-confound p1: architecture-bundle axis is the sole driver (+0.1179 BPB wikitext CI[0.1005,0.1354], 3 seeds, iso-FLOP); WSD and z-loss NOT significant
De-confound p2: value-residual +0.0355, layernorm-scaling +0.0337, head-gating +0.0256 BPB — each individually significant (3 seeds, iso-FLOP)
Data composition: dclm-edu code_py +0.7034; 50/50 mix +0.5904 CI[0.5532,0.6277] sig (=83.9% of the dclm code effect) while mix wikitext2 +0.0161 NOT significant (English retained)

Mid-training anneal: mix cooldown beats iso-token fineweb control on code_py +0.2716 CI[0.2641,0.2792] sig n=3; control≈base (+0.0050) — the LR-decay confound eaten; §C25 HARD-complete → win; §C18 confound_check recorded
ECL ladder: no rung regression; both arms fix the base 4096-dip (0.03→0.40); mix pooled 512-rung 0.82 vs base 0.20 (n=40/rung/cell, Wilson)

SFT: held-out masked reasoning PPL base 14.127 → SFT 11.573 / control 11.582; masking does NOT separate from iso-FLOP control (masked +0.009 sig, full-seq −0.006 n.s. → directional); no catastrophic forgetting
The eval-token confound: in-loop 0.68-PPL 'win' collapsed to ~0.01 on one fixed held-out response-masked set

RLVR: Phase-1 gate (SFT pass@1 1.1%/1.5%, pass@8 7%/10%); Phase-2 GRPO beats neither the SFT floor nor the random-reward gate (CIs overlap); training reward flat ~0.9% no trend; RFT 352/38,400 correct → cannot separate; pre-registered null confirmed
Context-extension gated off at step 0: base passkey 0.083 at its own 4096 window (threshold 0.5)

LIMITATION.claim: 2.14× of original PPL at ~30,000× less data (1.19B vs 36T); 3.5× at ~275,000× (131M)
LIMITATION.caveat: n=1, in-loop trainer eval (not suite-stamped); descriptive only
n=1 PPL; superseded by the de-confound's 3-seed BPB CIs — reported as motivation, not result
pre-registration said expected-null; reported as exploratory violation, not a claim

LIMITATION.claim: The 4096-dip anomaly and its repair by the anneal
LIMITATION.caveat: mechanism unexplained; passkey probe n=40/rung; flagged as open question
n=1 seed → directional by §C25 (pre-registered cap); multi-seed cohort deliberately not spent
